answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the crystal. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
